Notes: Bog's Monster Mash is a Content Patcher pack for Monster Variety: every drop is a vanilla item the framework adds to a vanilla mine monster in code, so each is a MonsterDrops row with its chance per kill (daily luck 0, no luck buff) worked out from Monster Variety 0.8.0 ManageVariety.ApplyMonsterVariety: the lowest Precedence among the varieties whose conditions pass wins, ties at random, then a RandomItemId list gives one of its items | Mapped with the default config: CT_MonstersEverywhere false (mines, Skull Cavern, Quarry Mine and the Farm), CT_SuperRareRate standard (super rare 0.19% a spawn with no luck buff), every CT_Enable switch on | (O)684: the mod removes the Bug's Bug Meat from Data/Monsters (the build records the removal); its Fly and Grub SharedExtraDrops of Bug Meat (50%, 1 to 2) get no row, because the data's Fly 0.9 and Grub 0.6 drops already make it dependable from floor 15 and the row would change no answer | (O)380: the iron golem row is a roll apart from the data's 10% Stone Golem iron, so it is written; ores keep their node weeks on the board (MetalsAvailability), as vanilla's own golem iron does | Duggy rows are seasonal: Monster Variety picks the variety by Game1.GetSeasonForLocation, the calendar season in the vanilla mines (TLY reads UndergroundMine as a location with no season of its own) | (O)276: the pumpkin skeleton shows only Fall 22 to 28 (SEASON_DAY), so it is an ExtraSources route with its own day table, not a MonsterDrops row | Metal Head furniture variety (RANDOM_ITEMS (F) @isRandomSale, about 57% a kill): a catalogue query of the kind vanilla leaves unresolved; no route | (O)Bogs.Monsters_*Soul: nine placeholder items the pack hands out nowhere (HUD icons for SUPER RARE APPEARED; Bog's Monster Sanctuary's content), loaded only without that mod: NeverSell | Sprite-only entries (Bats, slimes, Big Slime, Squid Kid Eye, Shadow Shaman Staff and Hat, seasonal Skeletons, Bug and Ghost colours, every DangerousVarieties entry) add nothing | Every drop at 0.19% a kill or less (the SUPER RARE APPEARED varieties, the Metal Head gem variety's Prismatic Shard, the gold artifacts and the 16 weapons, one of 16 at 2%) is a Chance ExtraSources route, not a MonsterDrops row, so the board never asks for it (Jeff, 2026-11-20); Spirit Torch at 1% stays a row (rare-drop rule, Winter) | The rows also size asks (LayerDropBases; Jeff, 2026-11-20, for Celjhyn's report of easy mushroom goals): measured with the mod applied on 2026-11-20 by entering each of mine floors 1 to 79 and sweeping it (tly_minesweep), 71 Dust Spirits on floors 41 to 79 dropped 49 Common Mushrooms (69%, computed 72.7%), 5 Morels and 7 Chanterelles, about 95 Common Mushrooms a week at 70 floors; the bases are Common Mushroom 99, Morel 26, Chanterelle 24 | Drops of 25% a kill or more are Dependable, the test TLY's own monster drops follow (Jeff, 2026-11-20)
